title: the VJP kernel a `neural_block` descriptor points to is an ordinary, launchable kernel
why: A `neural_block` descriptor only names kernels; it does not contain them.
This fixture is the actual kernel that row01's descriptor's `vjp_exec.kernel`
points to, and it is an ordinary launch-certified kernel with a real
argument spec — accepted at the shared validator, since that is the only
check meaningful for a real, standalone kernel.
It carries a recompute-only derivative block (kind `vjp`) naming the
descriptor's forward kernel as its primal, with an empty `residuals` list.
